title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Penalty Relief — Room Reservations Late Cancellations
content:
**Elite benefit.** On the penalty a late cancellation of a Room Reservations reservation owes, a guest whose attached Ashbury Rewards membership holds the Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite tier with at least 50 elite night credits this year has the top elite penalty relief of 40% taken off; one whose membership holds the Platinum Elite or Gold Elite tier with at least 25 elite night credits has the middle elite penalty relief of 20% taken off; any other guest has no elite penalty relief (0%).

**Where it acts.** The relief takes its share off the penalty owed before room tax is added to it; the result is rounded to the cent once, as the penalty owed.

**Records read.** The Ashbury Rewards membership attached to the reservation — its current tier and its elite night credits for the current calendar year.

| Tier of the attached membership | Elite night credits this year | Penalty relief |
|---|---|---|
| Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 50 or more | 40% |
| Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 49 or fewer | none |
| Platinum Elite or Gold Elite | 25 or more | 20% |
| Platinum Elite or Gold Elite | 24 or fewer | none |
| Silver Elite or Member | any | none |
| No membership attached | — | none |

**Illustration (hypothetical penalty night of 220.00, tax 12.5%).** Platinum Elite with 31 elite night credits: 220.00 less 20% is 176.00; with tax, 198.00 owed. Ambassador Elite with 50: 220.00 less 40% is 132.00; with tax, 148.50 owed. Titanium Elite with 12: no relief; with tax, 247.50 owed.
